Preserve relevant regression suites, avoid unrelated audits. Actual command uses exact /home/srinivas/.venvs/zerodha-phase1-r5/bin/python -I. Reports under reports/production/WP-R5-004/isolated_integration, code/tests under work/wp004_train_harness only. Finish with actual evidence, concrete remaining external prerequisites and stop.
